items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was living with John Lewis in Jamaica, New York, out in a nice neighborhood in Jamaica, because he saw in me talent and he wanted to enrich that and see.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was awful. I was living with John Lewis in Jamaica, New York, out in a nice neighborhood in Jamaica, because he saw in me talent and he wanted to enrich that and see. So when I was living on the Bowery, he said, “I can’t let you live like this.”
